events.verdict: Fox (SAC) closes out and makes marginal contact to Dick's (TOR) shooting hand after the completion of his release and follow through. The contact does not limit Dick's ability to land safely.
Mogbo (TOR) reaches in and makes contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm after his gather, which affects his driving shot attempt in the paint.
Fox (SAC) and Dick (TOR) come together off-ball and marginal contact occurs as they engage and disengage.

Fox (SAC) brings his left hand to the ball and dislodges it away from Barrett (TOR) during his dribble. The contact with Barrett's arm is simultaneous to Fox's contact with the ball, which results in a dislodge, and the arm contact is considered incidental.

Agbaji (TOR) holds his right arm out and marginal brush contact occurs with the back of Sabonis' (SAC) head during the rebounding opportunity. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.

Barrett (TOR) brings his right hand into the ball, dislodging it from Sabonis' (SAC) grasp. After the ball is dislodged, Barrett's hand comes into contact with Sabonis' wrist and the arm contact after the dislodge is considered incidental.
Fox (SAC) legally contests Dick's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
DeRozan (SAC) briefly brings his hands to Mogbo's (TOR) side as the shot attempt travels through the air and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly places and removes his hands from Mogbo's (TOR) front during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) brings his hands to rest on Mogbo's (TOR) side and the contact off-ball is marginal.
Agbaji's (TOR) left hand lightly brushes DeRozan's (SAC) arm during the shot attempt in the paint and the contact is marginal.
Barrett (TOR) repositions his pivot foot on the ground to create space from the defender while in possession of the ball.
Murray (SAC) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Barrett's (TOR) arm, which affects his SQBR while in possession of the ball.
Monk (SAC) brings his right hand to the ball and dislodges it away from Mitchell (TOR) during his dribble the drive. The arm contact after the dislodge is considered incidental.
Mitchell (TOR) is moving forwards as the ball is dislodged and incidental contact occurs between the ball and his leg.
Murray (SAC) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Barrett's (TOR) arm, which affects his SQBR at the start of his dribble drive.

Barrett's (TOR) left arm briefly comes to rest on DeRozan's (SAC) lower back as he jumps alongside DeRozan's path during the driving shot attempt. While in the air, Barrett's right arm comes down towards the ball slightly and brush contact occurs with DeRozan's arm. The contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Mogbo (TOR) avoids making illegal contact with DeRozan (SAC) during his contest of DeRozan's driving shot attempt.

Mitchell (TOR) extends his arm up to the ball and makes contact with it, which dislodges it from Sabonis' (SAC) grasp during the put-back attempt. The arm contact after the initial contact with the ball, which results in a dislodge, is considered incidental.
Mitchell (TOR) avoids making any illegal contact with Sabonis (SAC) during his contest of Sabonis' put-back attempt at the basket.
Fox (SAC) legally contests Barrett's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Monk (SAC) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick on Barrett (TOR).
Dick (TOR) brings his left hand to the ball and makes clean contact with it, which dislodges it away from DeRozan (SAC) as he attempts to secure the pass.
Ellis (SAC) brings his hand towards the ball and legally brushes it while it is in Barrett's (TOR) possession.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly rests and removes his hand from Mitchell's (TOR) front at the start of the drive and the contact is marginal.
Fox (SAC) legally contests Barrett's (TOR) jump shot attempt.

DeRozan (SAC) brings his hands to Boucher's (TOR) front as they engage while the shot travels through the air and marginal contact occurs as the two players disengage during the rebounding opportunity.
Mitchell (TOR) brings his hand towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Sabonis' (SAC) arm after he secures the loose ball.
Dick (TOR) raises his left hand up as he attempts to align along Fox's (SAC) path and contact occurs with Fox's head/face, which affects his SQBR during the drive.

Dick (TOR) briefly brings his right hand to rest on Fox's (SAC) side as he brings his left hand to the ball and dislodges it away from Fox during his dribble drive. The contact with Fox's side prior to the dislodge is marginal.
DeRozan (SAC) extends his arm out and makes contact with Barrett's (TOR) head, which alter his driving shot attempt at the basket.
Sabonis (SAC) is exiting the lane within three seconds.
Dick (TOR) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Sabonis (SAC) and Agbaji (TOR) engage and disengage and the contact is marginal.
Agbaji (TOR) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) and Dick (TOR) engage as Dick moves to set the pick and marginal contact occurs as they disengage.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly rests and removes his hands from Boucher's (TOR) torso and the contact prior to the pass is marginal.
Ellis (SAC) rests and promptly removes his hand from Dick's (TOR) side and the contact during the floater attempt is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) and Boucher (TOR) come together while the shot travels through the air and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick on Barrett (TOR).
Agbaji (TOR) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
In an attempt to tie up the ball, DeRozan (SAC) places and arm around Barrett's (TOR) side. A timeout is rewarded at the time of the defensive pressure.

Toronto requests and is granted a timeout while Barrett (TOR) is in possession of the ball. There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows whether DeRozan (SAC) is in contact with the ball at the time of Toronto's timeout request.
Sabonis (SAC) collapses his left arm against his torso as he firms up over his left leg and absorbs the contact with Barrett (TOR) during the screen.
Ellis (SAC) wraps his right arm around Barrett's (TOR) waist and initiates contact that affects Barrett's ability to get to the pass.
Mitchell (TOR) avoids making any illegal contact with DeRozan (SAC) during his contest of DeRozan's jump shot attempt.
Boucher (TOR) legally contests Fox's (SAC) jump shot attempt.

events.verdict: Fox (SAC) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Toronto.
DeRozan (SAC) brings his hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Dick (TOR), which he is able to play on through.
